sentences.text:
Opposite Party
 Mr. P.K. Mohanty, Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are accused in connection with G.R. Case No.612 of 2024 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C., Banarpal arising out of Bnarpal P.S. Case No.267 of 2024 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 420/294/506/34 IPC.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioners relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of their application for bail U/s.483 of BNSS by the learned Addl.
Sessions Judge, Angul by order dated 16.07.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

5. The allegation against the present Petitioners is that they duped the Informant of Rs.3,50,000/-
to provide grocery items at a less price.

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel that since charge sheet in the case at hand has been filed on 23.08.2024, further continuance of the Petitioner in custody is not warranted.
7. Learned counsel for the State opposes such prayer.

8. Taking into account the nature of allegation, this Court directs Petitioner No.1 (Binodini Muduli),
who is a lady, to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned court in seisin.

9. Liberty is given to Petitioner No.2 (Upendra Kumar Muduli @ Upendra Muduli) to renew his prayer before the learned Court in seisin which shall be considered on its own merit taking into account the filing of the charge sheet in the meanwhile.
10.
The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge PKS Signed by: PRADEEP KUMAR SWAIN
